one_liner: Senior executive-level director at FTA leading nationwide oversight of transit agencies' compliance with ADA, Title VI, and Disadvantaged Business Enterprise rules, supervising staff and budgets.
fit_summary: This GS-15 role requires a year at GS-14 level applying or overseeing ADA requirements in public transit, plus directing major programs and supervising staff. Daniel's resume has no transit or ADA work and no senior supervision, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens/nationals) under Direct Hire Authority; no federal status or veterans' preference needed.
Must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-14 that includes ADA application or oversight within public transit; this is mandatory, not a preference.
Same year must include executive-level briefings and stakeholder communication, plus managing/directing major programs and using data to defend decisions.
Background investigation required (no clearance), Selective Service registration if applicable, and a government travel card for job travel.
All qualifications must be met by the 11/02/2026 closing date; only two resume pages are reviewed.
strategy: Skip this one: his resume shows no public transit, ADA or civil-rights compliance work.
GS-11/12 emergency management or program analyst roles fit better.
resume_bullets: Led a five-person intake center for ReBuild NC after Hurricane Matthew (2019).
Studied social movements and human rights for an M.A. in Global Affairs (George Mason, 2016).
interview_questions: Describe a time you assessed a public transit agency's ADA compliance and how you resolved findings.
How have you used data to defend a controversial program decision to senior leadership?
How do you plan, assign, and evaluate the work of a supervisory team spread across locations?
How would you prioritize oversight of ADA, Title VI, and DBE programs with limited resources?
watch_outs: The ADA-in-public-transit specialized experience is a hard requirement; general emergency management or policy knowledge will not substitute.
GS-15 implies extensive senior supervisory experience; without it you will likely be rated ineligible in Phase I.
The job requires travel and carries a one-year probationary period plus a supervisory probationary period.
